reason: Expert provides a troubleshooting rule and successful workaround for when traffic does not pass after an SFP replacement on older transmission units.

knowledge.summary: On older transmission equipment, traffic may not pass after replacing an SFP even though the link is up and alarms are cleared; bounce the interface to restore traffic rather than rebooting the entire unit.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Forwarding gets stuck after optic replacement on older units installed around 2018.
